title: echinops spinosissimus subsp. neumayeri
intro: Echinops spinosissimus subsp. neumayeri, commonly known as the Neumayer's Globe Thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Echinops spinosissimus subsp. neumayeri include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, relax muscles, and relieve coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
